title: ECC Bursary 2027
description: Early Career Conference bursary, 20 Feb 2027. The real first round. Up to $500 travel reimbursement (handled offline) plus free ECC registration.
_note: Declaration, T&C and guidance wording drafted from the spec; check it against the PDF 'QHTA Bursary Application — Early Career Conference 20 Feb 2027' before opening the round.

config.privacy_notice: QHTA collects the details on this form to assess your bursary application. They are seen by QHTA administrators and the bursary selection committee; the committee sees your written piece without your name or school. Your referee receives your name and the program name so they can confirm your application. If your application is not successful, your personal details and any documents are removed 12 months after the round closes. Contact qhta@qhta.com.au with any privacy questions.

fields.label: Email
fields.help: We send your reference number and all correspondence here.

fields.label: QCT registration number
fields.help: Your Queensland College of Teachers registration number. QHTA checks this manually.

fields.label: QHTA membership
fields.help: Bursaries are open to QHTA members, either individually or through your school's institutional membership.

fields.label: I live and work outside South-East Queensland
fields.help: The bursary supports teachers in regional, rural and remote areas.

fields.label: Being an early career History teacher in Regional, Rural and Remote Australia
fields.help:
Up to 300 words. You might consider:
• what drew you to teaching History, and to teaching outside South-East Queensland
• the opportunities and challenges of teaching History in your school and community
• how you build your knowledge and practice when colleagues and resources are far away
• what you hope to gain from the Early Career Conference
• how you will share what you learn with your school or region
Do not include your name or school in your piece — the selection committee reads it anonymously.
Your referee should be your Deputy Principal or Principal. We email them a link to confirm your application; it is not complete until they do.

fields.label: I am not yet in a teaching post for 2027
fields.help: Tick this to nominate another professional referee instead (e.g. a university supervisor or mentor teacher).

declarations.text: I have read and accept the terms and conditions of the QHTA Early Career Conference Bursary: the bursary is open to early career History teachers who are registered with the Queensland College of Teachers, are QHTA members (individually or through an institutional membership), and live and work outside South-East Queensland. Successful applicants receive free registration to the Early Career Conference on 20 February 2027 and reimbursement of travel costs up to $500 on presentation of receipts. Bursaries are not transferable and cannot be exchanged for cash.
If successful, I will attend the Early Career Conference on 20 February 2027.
I will provide receipts for travel costs claimed for reimbursement.
If I am unable to attend, I will notify QHTA as soon as possible and return any bursary funds already paid to me.
I accept that the selection committee's decision is final and no correspondence will be entered into.

confirmer.label: Referee
confirmer.declaration: I confirm that the applicant is known to me in a professional capacity, that to the best of my knowledge the details in this application are true, and that I support their application for the QHTA Early Career Conference Bursary.
